MOLI_TOKEN.description: Access token. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>, as ?token=<token> in the URL, or as the password for user moli (WebDriver). Without it every request gets 401.

MOLI_ARGS.description: Extra flags for moli serve. --layout enables screenshots and coordinate clicks; add --resource to also load images, fonts and media, or --http-proxy <url> to route traffic through a proxy.

PORT.description: Port of the token gate behind the Railway domain - leave as is.
